ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white fields occupy the center of both lobes. High-contrast black pigmentation is concentrated in a broad wedge around the median notch and extends along the trailing and leading edges. A distinctive, isolated vertical black linear blob is located on the upper-mid section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped indentation with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (small peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge from the notch to the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature on the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering to acute points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, high-contrast calcified white/tan pixel groups (barnacles) located on both fluke tips. Scattered circular white depigmentation spots are visible on the lower-left white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical dark linear mark on the right lobe white field. A faint diagonal linear disruption is visible on the lower quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both lobes; visible pitting and localized scarring across the white ventral regions.
other_distinctive_markers: The vertical black streak on the right lobe serves as a unique high-contrast identifier against the white background.
